context: Evaluates the useNavActions composable, which tightly couples async Wails backend calls with immediate Pinia store mutations. Key aspects are correct DTO construction from backend responses, matching the right level via parentId stack lookup, and routing delete calls to the correct backend function based on item kind.

checklist.name: Backend call integration
checklist.description: createNotebook calls CreateNotebook, createNote calls CreateNote, and deleteItem calls DeleteNotebook or DeleteNote depending on item.kind, all with the correct argument shapes.

checklist.name: DTO construction
checklist.description: After creation, a new NotebookListItem (for notebooks) or NoteListItem (for notes) is constructed from the backend response and used as the item inserted into the store.

checklist.name: Level matching by parentId
checklist.description: The composable finds the correct NavLevel in the navigation store's stack by comparing level.parentId, then mutates that level's items array to append the new item.

checklist.name: Post-create navigation
checklist.description: After createNotebook inserts the item, it calls nav.openNotebook with the new notebook data. After createNote inserts the item, it calls nav.selectNote with the new note's id.

checklist.name: Delete routing by kind
checklist.description: deleteItem calls DeleteNotebook when item.kind === 'notebook' and DeleteNote when item.kind === 'note', then calls nav.removeItem with the level's parentId, the item's id, and the item's kind.
